description: Roll out a feature store (Feast) for ML feature management. Must: define feature specifications, backfill historical features from data warehouse, deploy Feast online serving, verify online-offline parity, integrate with ML training pipeline, and monitor feature freshness. Risk factors: online-offline parity skew, backfill taking too long, feature definitions conflicting, serving latency impacting real-time inference. Tools available: Feast, Redis, BigQuery, Kubernetes, Python.
